description: Pinned external skill stack for Webman. Every repository referenced by SUPER_PROMPT.md is recorded here with the exact commit it was last verified against. validate.py enforces that SUPER_PROMPT.md only references pinned repositories and (with --check-remotes) that each pinned commit still exists upstream. Update a pin deliberately: review the diff, then update the commit field.
